name: brash_taunter_spared_by_the_damage_division
notes: Bug hunt 2026-11-17 (hunt2 t_taunter_block). A 5/5 attacks and is blocked by Brash Taunter (indestructible 1/1: 'Whenever this creature is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to target opponent') and a 2/2 Bear. Its controller divides its 5 damage among its blockers as they choose (CR 510.1c), here none to the Taunter and all 5 to the Bear: the Bear dies, the Taunter is dealt nothing and deals nothing, and seat 0 stays at 20. Failed before: the engine asked a damage assignment order and assigned lethal damage first, at least 1 to the Taunter, which came back.
